method: transaction-local audit-prune guard with task-specific predicate
sql: BEGIN; SELECT set_config('commercehub.audit_prune_before', :cutoff, true); DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE created_at >= :start AND created_at < :cutoff AND user_agent = 'FE-IDN-005 acceptance browser' AND actor_id=1 AND tenant_id=1 AND id>1806; COMMIT;
